description: This file provides functions for sending messages and photos via Zalo, including resolving context with tokens and proxies, and handling success/failure responses.

methods.name: toZaloSendResult
methods.description: Converts API response to ZaloSendResult format.

methods.name: runZaloSend
methods.description: Executes send operation with error handling, returning ZaloSendResult.

methods.name: resolveSendContext
methods.description: Resolves token and fetcher based on options and configuration.

methods.name: resolveValidatedSendContext
methods.description: Validates and resolves chat ID, token, and fetcher for sending.

methods.name: resolveSendContextOrFailure
methods.description: Resolves context or returns failure result.

methods.name: sendMessageZalo
methods.description: Sends a text message or photo to a Zalo chat.

methods.name: sendPhotoZalo
methods.description: Sends a photo to a Zalo chat.
